updates.summary: Prisma 7 moves the connection URL to prisma.config.ts and replaces the prisma-client-js generator.
changes: Key Concepts — generator block now `prisma-client` with `output`; datasource block no longer has `url`; added a `prisma.config.ts` example (schema path, `datasource.url`, `dotenv/config`).
Key Concepts — custom schema location is set in `prisma.config.ts` instead of `package.json` "prisma"; multi-file schema is GA since Prisma 6.7 (was "Prisma 5.15 preview / standard in 7").
Interview Q&A — generator described as `prisma-client` (not `prisma-client-js`); URL lives in `prisma.config.ts`; multi-file schema version corrected.
Coding Challenge — challenge text and solution use the `prisma-client` generator with `output` and no datasource `url`.

updates.summary: In Prisma 7 the datasource block has no url/directUrl/shadowDatabaseUrl: the CLI reads prisma.config.ts and the app passes a URL to a driver adapter.
changes: TL;DR — rewritten: datasource only declares `provider`; URL goes in `prisma.config.ts` (CLI) and `PrismaPg` adapter (runtime).

Key Concepts — `url`/`directUrl`/`shadowDatabaseUrl` examples replaced by `prisma.config.ts` + adapter code; pooled-vs-direct URL split explained for Prisma 7; `?pgbouncer=true&connection_limit=1` replaced by pool option `max`; MongoDB marked unsupported in Prisma 7; `.env` is no longer auto-loaded.
Why It Matters / Interview Q&A — "url vs directUrl" question reworded as pooled (adapter) vs direct (config) URL.
Common Pitfalls — credentials example now shows `prisma.config.ts` instead of `url = "..."` in the schema.
Coding Challenge — Supabase solution now uses `prisma.config.ts` (direct URL) plus `PrismaPg` adapter (pooled URL, `max: 1`); `.env.example` no longer uses Prisma-specific pooler params.

updates.summary: The generator lesson now teaches the Prisma 7 `prisma-client` generator: required output, ESM, driver adapters, no binaryTargets.
changes: TL;DR / Key Concepts — `prisma-client-js` → `prisma-client`; `output` is required; client no longer in `node_modules`; import path is the generated folder; adapter example added; ESM/Node requirements added.
Key Concepts — `binaryTargets` section replaced: no Rust engine binary in Prisma 7, so normally not needed; preview feature list updated (multiSchema, tracing, driverAdapters are GA).
Why It Matters / Interview Q&A — rewritten around generated source in your tree and `prisma generate` after `migrate dev`; added "prisma-client vs prisma-client-js" question.
Common Pitfalls — now "old generator and import path / client without adapter".
Coding Challenge — no `binaryTargets`; includes `prisma.config.ts`, `"type": "module"`, and a singleton using `PrismaPg`.
